http_header
Description
Evaluates the string following an HTTP header tag that you specify.
This command is a BIG-IP version 4.X variable, provided for
backward-compatibility. You can use the equivalent 9.X command
HTTP::header
, instead.
Syntax
http_header
(
header_tag_string
)
http_header(header_tag_string)
Evaluates the string following an HTTP header tag that you specify.
